THE MAINTENANCE BENCH

More of your Pocket,
in one place.

Each task has its own scope and review. Core changes and firmware staging stay separate.

01 / CORESA readable inventory
Search, compare, and select cores. Preview the file changes and start with curated collections.
02 / SAVE VAULTKeep your progress close
Create local snapshots of saves and Memories. Review selected restores before writing them to your card.
03 / FIRMWAREA deliberate update
Check the official PocketOS source, verify the published checksum, and explicitly stage firmware.
04 / HEALTHUnderstand your target
Read-only checks flag incomplete folders, unreadable core metadata, and low free space.
05 / ASSETSMake it yours
Inspect and manage optional palettes and supported image assets through scoped review workflows.
06 / DIAGNOSTICSUseful when you need help
Export local diagnostics with target paths and exception messages omitted, then choose what to share.

READY TO TRY IT?

A little less maintenance.
A little more play.

Start with the Windows technical preview. Extract the ZIP, keep its files together, and launch EzPocket.exe. No separate .NET runtime is needed.

BEFORE YOU START

This is early development software. The Windows preview is unsigned; Windows may show a security warning and organization policies may block it. Keep a separate backup of important card content.
